description:
## Issue summary

React Native (Expo) mobile flows for Mobile hardening with offline-safe behaviour.

**Project:** great-ptw-loto-ai-app
**Sprint:** SP-08.02 (Execution order: 14)
**Layer:** MOB
**Priority:** Medium (3)

## Positive test cases

- Core workflow usable offline with queued sync
- Auth tokens stored securely
- Offline changes reconcile without data loss
- UI reflects connectivity state clearly

## Negative test cases

- Authoritative data stored only in SQLite
- Sync overwrites newer local changes silently
- Crash on network loss mid-submit

## Acceptance criteria

- Mobile screens implemented for sprint scope
- Offline queue + sync tested
- TypeScript lint passes

## Definition of Done

- Expo app runs on iOS/Android simulator
- Offline scenario manually verified
- No secrets in mobile bundle

---

## Existing notes

Mobile performance and security hardening for **SP-08.02 — Security & Performance Hardening**.

## Areas of work

* Mobile app startup time and rendering performance tuning
* Offline synchronisation efficiency (SQLite query optimisation, sync batching)
* Secure local storage review (SQLite encryption, credential handling)
* Certificate pinning / secure API communication review
* Background upload queue reliability under poor network conditions

… (truncated, use `get_issue` for full description)
